verdict.rationale: Termius ships Mosh as a host protocol, and its docs explicitly recommend it for 'connection stability while changing networks'. That covers the network-change half of the story, and a community user values the built-in Mosh support. Nothing in the evidence addresses sessions surviving device sleep or backgrounding. missing for 10: documented session persistence across device sleep/app backgrounding, hands-on corroboration of sessions surviving network roaming, details on reconnection behavior.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep my terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep

citations.quote: enable Mosh when you need connection stability while changing networks
supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP
Free Mosh support is a huge plus.
